system.description:
Effect - Numbness, brings on pleasant thoughts, -1 action, +50% bonus against pain, fear and madness; lasts 4d6 hours. 65% chance to remove one point of Madness
Toxicity - 6
Production Bonus - -20% -> 10 doses
Ingredients - Distillate, Pa, Pa, Al, Yl, Mandrake
Addictiveness - Will Test (Very hard), rolled only when the drug actually removes a point of Madness. Once the taker has been cured of this addiction before, the Test is at -60% instead
Withdrawal - 4d6 hours; Will -2; Success -10%
Treatment - Will Test -20% every 5 days; 6 successes
